quarterly_data.quarter: IQM Quantum Computers press release: LUMI AI Factory selects IQM's staged path to Europe's first (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IQM set out the three-step delivery of LUMI-IQ, its logical-qubit-capable system for the LUMI AI Factory led by CSC (jointly owned by Finland, Czechia, Norway and Poland and jointly funded by the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking), to be hosted in CSC's new data center in Kajaani and integrated with LUMI-AI: an IQM Halocene H4 system with 150 physical qubits and early quantum error correction installed in 2027, an upgrade in 2028 for lower logical error rates and real-time error correction, and installation of an IQM Halocene H5 system in 2029; after the final upgrade it will run computations with up to 9 logical qubits (distance 3 surface code and colour code). The release says this follows IQM's roadmap for fault-tolerant quantum computing by 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: Halocene H4 with 150 physical qubits in 2027; upgrade 2028; Halocene H5 in 2029; up to 9 logical qubits
